name: construction-scenes
notes: Six new source clips, three real and three generated, broadly matched on daylight crane/construction subject matter and ground/elevated viewpoint counts (two ground and one elevated per origin). Real clips are dated 2015, 2019 and 2022 from two creators; generated clips are two Sora 2 Pro and one Veo 3.1 via SynthSite. These are coarse content/viewpoint groups, not exact scene pairs. Sources, codecs, resolutions, framing and durations still differ; model center crops can exclude cranes and workers. Original file bytes and native preprocessing are retained. See configs/construction-scenes-selection.md; fixed descriptive 0.5 reference, no calibration or model changes. RGB-only/sparse-frame AIGVDet and sparse-frame WaveRep adaptations remain. No deployment change follows from this pilot.
